_comment: Storia egg for Pterodactyl / Pelican. https://github.com/AKSHRK-Dev/Storia
name: Storia
author: support@ashikanw.com
description: Storia is a Folia fork for large Minecraft servers: multithreaded regions, a RAM world, fast pre-generation and Storia Cluster. This egg installs the Storia server jar from GitHub Releases.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Storia installer: downloads storia-<version>.jar from GitHub Releases.
# STORIA_VERSION is "latest" (newest stable release) or a version such as 26.2-10 or 26.2-9-beta.
apk add --no-cache curl ca-certificates >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

REPO="AKSHRK-Dev/Storia"
VERSION="${STORIA_VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
  # /releases/latest redirects to /releases/tag/v<version>; no API token or rate limit needed
  TAG=$(curl -fsSI "https://github.com/$REPO/releases/latest" | grep -i '^location:' | sed 's#.*/tag/##' | tr -d '\r')
  if [ -z "$TAG" ]; then
    echo "Could not find the latest Storia release."
    exit 1
  fi
  VERSION="$TAG"
fi
VERSION="${VERSION#v}"

URL="https://github.com/$REPO/releases/download/v$VERSION/storia-$VERSION.jar"
echo "Installing storia $VERSION"
echo "  $URL"
if ! curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "$URL"; then
  echo "Download failed. Check that STORIA_VERSION ($VERSION) exists on https://github.com/$REPO/releases"
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
  printf 'server-ip=0.0.0.0\nserver-port=25565\nquery.port=25565\n' > server.properties
fi
echo "Done."

variables.name: Server jar file
variables.description: The name of the jar file to run.

variables.name: Storia version
variables.description: "latest" for the newest stable release, or a version such as 26.2-10 or 26.2-9-beta (see https://github.com/AKSHRK-Dev/Storia/releases). Reinstall the server to change it.
